messages:
sam: Heads up — want quick sync on new autofallback default for API v2 rollout. Proposal: default to `soft-degrade` (return cached/short-response + metadata) for a 30s recoverability window instead of an immediate hard switch. Thoughts?

marta: +1 to soft-degrade as the default. Observability concern: how do we signal in the console/graphs that a latency spike triggered degrade vs a model error? Need a distinct telemetry tag.

jen: We can reuse the `route_decision` span attribute and add `fallback.mode=soft` and `fallback.trigger=latency|error|quota`. That will let folks filter traces and create alerts.

ben: Billing note — if soft-degrade still touches the model/cache it might incur tokens. Suggest soft-degrade responses be token-cheap (truncate + auto-summary) and include `billing_exempt=false|true` flag in the event so finance can decide.

pk: UX question: console should surface when a policy is in preview/dry-run so we don't cause alert fatigue. Maybe a `preview` badge + sample rate indicator (e.g., "preview 5% traffic").

sam: Agree on trace tags and preview badge. Also: can we capture sampled full-request audit traces at 1% when in soft-degrade so SREs can diagnose without blowing up storage? Sampling should be configurable per-customer.

marta: Ops requirement: explicit rollback TTL. If soft-degrade engages, auto-revert after N consecutive successful non-degraded requests (or after a time window). This will help avoid oscillation during flakey infra.

jen: Implementation detail — runtime needs new `decision_reason` enum values. I'll add `DEGRADED_SOFT`, `DEGRADED_HARD`, and `ESCALATED_FALLBACK` so the control-plane and traces have consistent semantics.

ben: Action items: jen -> PR for runtime enum + trace tags; sam -> draft console badge + dry-run UI copy; pk -> confirm billing treatment with Finance; ops-bot -> create infra ticket and link.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-4821 autofallback soft-degrade telemetry + UX (https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4821)

marta: :thumbsup: Nice. Let's target a 5% canary next week and collect traces for two days, then reconvene to decide widen/rollback.
